Source_Backed_Behavior: A temporary in-battle skill used to attack or defend. Active skills normally have five levels and may have an EVO.
What_It_Can_Affect: Attack behavior, projectiles, fields, explosions, healing or control.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No universal damage coefficient or formula is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A temporary in-battle passive that changes a stat or is required to evolve an active skill.
What_It_Can_Affect: ATK, cooldown, duration, range, movement, healing, HP or utility.
Known_Examples: Energy Cube, HE Fuel, Hi-Power Bullet
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: A passive is not assumed to affect skills unless its wording says so.

Source_Backed_Behavior: The final form of an active or weapon skill, usually requiring a named passive or combination skill.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Base skill at the required level plus its evolution requirement.
Known_Examples: RPG → Sharkmaw Gun; Molotov → Fuel Barrel
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Evolution is not treated as a generic fixed damage multiplier.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Damage caused when an attack directly contacts a target.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No hit-rate assumption is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A moving attack object that can travel, bounce, return, home or penetrate.
What_It_Can_Affect: Hit count, target coverage and repeated contact.
Known_Examples: Kunai, Drill Shot, Soccer Ball, Boomerang
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Projectile speed, hit count and collision rules are not inferred when absent.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Allows a projectile or attack to pass through additional enemies.
What_It_Can_Affect: Number of targets a single attack can contact.
Known_Examples: Drill Shot, Gravity Controller Brick, Caltrops spikes
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No extra damage per penetrated target is assumed.

Source_Backed_Behavior: An impact, mine, rocket or triggered event damages an area.
What_It_Can_Affect: Area hits and additional hit events.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Explosion overlap and target caps are not assumed.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A line or path-based energy attack.
Known_Examples: Laser Launcher, Death Ray, Eternal Laser
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Tick interval and stored-damage behavior are only recorded where explicitly stated.

Source_Backed_Behavior: An area persists around a location or the player and affects targets inside it.
What_It_Can_Affect: Continuous contact damage, status, healing or control.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Tick rate and uptime are not invented.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A damaging or status area is left on the ground or behind a moving source.
What_It_Can_Affect: Targets crossing or standing in the patch.
Known_Examples: Molotov fire, Eternal Boots trail, Croaky slime
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Patch overlap and exact tick timing are not inferred.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Damage occurs across a stated period or through repeated ticks.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No universal tick formula or stacking rule is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: An attack steers toward or prioritizes targets.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Target must be within the source-stated range.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No accuracy percentage is assigned.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Adds projectiles, missiles, bullets, blades or simultaneous attacks.
Known_Examples: RPG +1 rocket; Destroyer missiles; additional sword array
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Added attacks are not converted to damage without verified hit behavior.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Changes how often an attack or skill can be used.
Known_Examples: Energy Cube, Battle Lust, reload reduction
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No DPS conversion formula is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Changes how long a field, projectile, buff, debuff or state lasts.
What_It_Can_Affect: Time the effect can remain active.
Known_Examples: Exo-Bracer, Quantum Ball duration, debuff duration
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: 100% uptime is never assumed unless a source explicitly says it is continuous.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Changes attack reach, field radius, projectile size or explosion coverage.
What_It_Can_Affect: Probability and number of targets contacted.
Known_Examples: HE Fuel, Forcefield size, explosion radius
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No direct damage gain is assigned to area alone.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A source-stated ATK increase changes the attack stat of the named owner, Survivor or pet.
What_It_Can_Affect: Attacks that use that named ATK stat.
Required_Condition_or_Source: The bonus is active for its stated scope.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No conversion from ATK to final damage is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A source-stated bonus to skill damage.
What_It_Can_Affect: Skills covered by the source wording.
Required_Condition_or_Source: The skill or condition named by the source is active.
Known_Examples: Common Pointless, tech resonance, pet Encouragement
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No additive/multiplicative bucket or stacking formula is assumed.
Source_Status: Drive source; exact formula intentionally excluded

Source_Backed_Behavior: A source-stated bonus limited to the equipped weapon or named weapon family.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Not treated as global Skill Damage.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Changes the chance that eligible damage events are critical hits.
What_It_Can_Affect: Eligible attacks or skills named by the source.
Required_Condition_or_Source: The source bonus and attack eligibility are active.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Crit cap, overcap and expected-damage formulas are deliberately omitted pending verification.
Source_Status: Drive source notes exact formula unverified

Source_Backed_Behavior: Changes damage of eligible critical hits.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Base crit damage, stacking order and overcap behavior are not assumed.
Source_Status: Drive source notes exact formula unverified

Source_Backed_Behavior: A source-stated damage bonus associated with an Energy Shield or shield-related condition.
What_It_Can_Affect: Damage while the source-stated shield condition is satisfied.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Energy Shield or named shield condition is active.
Known_Examples: SS gear, Xeno assists, mount components
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: It is not applied without verified shield state; stacking formula is omitted.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A source-stated bonus against bosses or elites.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Target is a boss or elite.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No boss-defense formula is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Increases damage received by the affected enemy according to the source wording.
Known_Examples: Yang vortex, Joey Exposed, Croaky corrosion, Deep Wounds
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Different damage-taken effects are not automatically combined or stacked.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Slows or freezes enemies and enables source-stated damage to Chilled targets.
Required_Condition_or_Source: A Chill source is active on the target.
Known_Examples: Glacial Warboots, King Blizzblast, Guardian/Drill effects
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Chill is not assumed to increase damage by itself unless wording says damage taken increases.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Applies a Poison status or damage-over-time effect and enables source-stated damage to Poisoned targets.
What_It_Can_Affect: Poison ticks and conditional Poisoned-target bonuses.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Poison tick damage and stacking are not assumed.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Reduces enemy attack in source descriptions and enables damage to Weakened targets.
What_It_Can_Affect: Enemy offense and conditional Weakened-target bonuses.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Weaken does not automatically mean increased damage taken unless separately stated.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Applies the Lacerated status and enables source-stated damage to Lacerated targets.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Laceration damage, duration and stacking are not generalized.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Applies Bleed or a Bleed-linked damage effect.
What_It_Can_Affect: Repeated damage or linked mechanics as stated.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Bleed and Laceration are not treated as identical unless a source explicitly links them.

Source_Backed_Behavior: A fire/Molotov-linked effect that increases damage taken according to source wording.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Deep Wounds is applied and active.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: It is not merged with Vulnerability without verified stacking behavior.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Reduces movement or restrains enemies.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Control effect applies to the target.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No direct damage bonus is assumed unless separately stated.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Damage dealt during a charge window may be stored and released later when explicitly stated.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Charge state and target condition are active.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Stored damage is not treated as ordinary immediate damage or given a formula beyond source wording.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Defeats eligible non-boss or non-invincible enemies without normal damage resolution.
Required_Condition_or_Source: Source condition and exclusions are met.
Known_Examples: Fingerless Gloves, Chaos effects, Sword of Disorder AF
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Bosses, elites and invincible enemies are excluded when the source says so.

Source_Backed_Behavior: An effect chooses a damage value within a stated range.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No average value is included.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Damage or damage bonuses depend on movement, speed, trails or charge built while moving.
What_It_Can_Affect: Named mount, boots or trail effect.
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No movement uptime is assumed.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Kills, hits, souls, energy or repeated actions build named stacks that change later effects.
What_It_Can_Affect: Only the named item or skill.
Known_Examples: Sword of Disorder souls, Joey Exposed stacks, Stardust Sash energy
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: Stack rate, maximum uptime and average value are not calculated.

Source_Backed_Behavior: Damage or buffs occur after death, revival or while in a temporary death-prevention state.
Known_Examples: Eternal Suit, Armor of Quietus, Voidwaker Windbreaker
Not_Assumed_or_Unverified: No assumed number of activations beyond source wording.
